note: V28.36 Router fix: the pool's exit-to-home used Router.load('home'), but the canonical route is 'main' (router.js has no 'home' route), so the call failed and the pool fell back to DOM hacks, leaving currentRoute inconsistent (back/history quirks). Changed the two Router.load('home') calls to Router.load('main'); the DOM-selector fallback is kept in try/catch. No other behavior changed. (Deeper router unification — removing Router.load interceptions, normalizing home/main in v20-stable-base — remains a larger task that needs live testing.)
